name: merge-field-check
title: Merge Field Check
description: Template editor for bulk email and SMS that renders the message per recipient and flags unknown fields (with typo suggestions), broken braces and recipients with no value (spaces count as empty), with one-tap fixes and fallbacks, and steps to the recipients who'd get a gap.

meta.summary: Renders a mail-merge template for each real recipient, so nothing goes out as "Hi ," or "{{frist_name}}".
catches: Unknown fields, with typo suggestions (frist_name → first_name)
Recipients with an empty or whitespace-only value
limits: Understands {{field}} and {{field | default: "…"}} only, not full Liquid or Handlebars
Checks the recipients you pass, not your whole list
a11y: Visible label; textarea has aria-invalid for template errors and is described by the issues list
Issues list is a polite live region
Fixes are buttons; focus returns to the textarea
